name: Kawasaki KZ1300 / Z1300
engine: 1286 cc liquid-cooled DOHC inline six, three carbs (later fuel injected), shaft drive
intro: Kawasaki's liquid-cooled six. The water pump drive and its mechanical seal are the big worry.

add.title: Check the water pump and its seal
add.instructions: Check the oil for coolant and the weep hole for drips. Inspect the water pump drive and mechanical seal.
add.reason: A failed mechanical seal puts coolant in the oil.

G: Early bikes have carbs and later ones are fuel injected. Skip the steps that don't match your bike.

recallNote: Any recalls on bikes this old were closed long ago.

known.title: Water pump seal
known.what: A broken water pump mechanical seal can let coolant into the oil.
